title: What is Quantization?
description: Quantization shrinks a model by storing its weights in fewer bits so it fits smaller GPUs and laptops. How lower precision trades a little accuracy for speed and where builders reach for it.
lead: Quantization converts a model's weights from roomy high-precision numbers into compact lower-precision ones. The model keeps most of its skill while needing far less memory and answering noticeably faster. It is the standard move behind running capable models on a laptop or a single small graphics card, trading a small accuracy cost for a large efficiency win.
